proves.claim: each supported person intent becomes literal CLI arguments.

person.request.intents-become-args.why: An intent turned into shell text instead of arguments would let a request run more than it names.

proves.claim: person intent preserves literal leading-dash values and forces person answers.

person.request.keeps-dash-values.why: A value starting with a dash was read as a flag and changed what the command did.

proves.claim: request documents reject engine operations, impersonation and malformed arguments.

person.request.rejects-unsafe-documents.why: A person's request must never reach an engine operation or act as another principal.

proves.claim: versioned person requests reject newer formats and unstable identifiers.

person.request.rejects-newer-formats.why: An older build must refuse a request it cannot read rather than guess its meaning.

proves.claim: a pairing QR matches the independent complete symbol and prints its quiet zone.

person.qr.matches-reference-symbol.why: A QR that differs from the reference symbol would not scan, so pairing fails with no message.

proves.claim: every person-cell test registered here has a stable ID and one complete record, and an unregistered test is reported and fails only with tests.registryStrict on.

person.registry.complete.why: Without a record per test a test can be deleted or duplicated with no one noticing what it proved.
